name: recycler-progression
title: Recycler Progression
author: Morlot
description:
Adds three recycler tiers (Recycler 1–3) that lead up to the vanilla recycler (Recycler 4).
Paranoidal port of Recycler Progression 1.1.1 for Factorio 2.0 + Quality: Recycler 1 is available from the start, recipes and technologies use the Paranoidal tree.
